SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COMPANION_REVIEW R WHERE R.STATUS = 'Y'
AND (UPPER(R.TITLE) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{search}) || '%' OR UPPER(R.CONTENT) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{search}) || '%')

SELECT R.REVIEW_NO, R.COMPANION_NO, R.MEMBER_NO, R.TITLE, R.CONTENT, R.RATING, R.IMAGE_URL, R.CONTENT_IMAGES, R.STATUS, TO_CHAR(R.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS CREATED_AT, TO_CHAR(R.UPDATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS UPDATED_AT, M.NICKNAME AS AUTHOR_NICKNAME, M.PROFILE_IMAGE AS AUTHOR_PROFILE, CB.TITLE AS COMPANION_TITLE FROM COMPANION_REVIEW R JOIN MEMBER M ON R.MEMBER_NO = M.MEMBER_NO LEFT JOIN COMPANION_BOARD CB ON R.COMPANION_NO = CB.COMPANION_NO WHERE R.REVIEW_NO = #{reviewNo} AND R.STATUS = 'Y'

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT R.REVIEW_NO, R.COMPANION_NO, R.MEMBER_NO, R.TITLE, R.CONTENT, R.RATING, R.IMAGE_URL, R.CONTENT_IMAGES, R.STATUS, TO_CHAR(R.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS CREATED_AT, M.NICKNAME AS AUTHOR_NICKNAME, M.PROFILE_IMAGE AS AUTHOR_PROFILE, CB.TITLE AS COMPANION_TITLE FROM COMPANION_REVIEW R JOIN MEMBER M ON R.MEMBER_NO = M.MEMBER_NO LEFT JOIN COMPANION_BOARD CB ON R.COMPANION_NO = CB.COMPANION_NO WHERE R.STATUS = 'Y' ORDER BY R.RATING DESC, R.CREATED_AT DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit}
